issue: Direct operator instruction; no tracker issue.
scope: show all four feature-card descriptions without detail toggles or clipping
remove the guessing marquee and evidence-delivery sections
render ten FAQ items after excluding two requested questions
remove metric and imperial navigation state
show locale flags and currency symbols in the header and language modal
preserve Chinese, English, Spanish, Russian, and Arabic localization with Arabic RTL
rewrite README and project documentation around VisePanda

No real AI, account, Trip, booking, payment, Human Help, or persistence integration
decisions: Keep app/page.tsx as a Server Component and isolate interactions in components/VisePandaLanding.tsx.

blockers: Bundled local fonts and existing shape masks need rights review before public release.
VisePanda production interfaces and backends are not connected.
verification: five-locale flag and currency interaction checks
next_action: Commit the verified change, push main, and confirm the exact Vercel deployment status.
